notes: Meaningful activity is an accepted human action; visits are separate. Completed activities are submitted work or logged project time, reading, movement or positive habits. Rewards and approvals are engagement but not additional completed activities.

Collection begins with this deployment; earlier activity is not reconstructed. Empty or partial history does not establish zero earlier usage. Live-check families, MCP and background automation are excluded.
Raw usage is retained for 90 UTC calendar days with daily cleanup. Account and family deletion also remove linked usage; historical totals can change after deletion.
Visits count accounts seen in the foreground once per UTC day, including multiple devices. Visits have no feature attribution; a feature filter does not change visit counts.
The weekly summary is the latest seven UTC days including today and honors role and feature filters. Onboarding and family retention include all roles and features.
Reliability counts and workflow abandonment are unavailable here; use the existing error monitoring for error investigations.

onboarding.coverage: Families created during the selected period after collection began; steps progress through the report end. All roles and features are included. Deleted accounts and families are excluded.

retention.definition: Families active in the week one or four weeks before the latest fully completed UTC Monday–Sunday week, returning in that latest week. Activity requires a meaningful human action. Both full weeks need observed history. Scope applies; date-range, role and feature filters do not alter these whole-family cohorts.

friction.notes: Pending reviews are the current backlog regardless of date or role. Median approval time covers parent-approved homework and chores decided during the selected period; the child role filter has no approvals. Both honor the feature filter.
